Game Overview

In Grenade Simulator, the core idea is straightforward: unleash chaos in Grenade Simulator, the ultimate explosive playground. Dive into heart-racing action as you hurl grenades, plant mines, and create massive blasts. Discover the thrill of wielding different bombs and mastering epic detonations in this high-octane adventure.
